args.text:
MISSION COMPLETE — spare ORU ORU-0417 delivered to the PDU-1 spares shelf; rover returned to dock with arm stowed.

WHAT WAS OBSERVED
- Manifest (read-only): ORU-0417, orbital replacement unit, recorded at depot_stand/slot_0, status serviceable. Noted the adjacent slot_1 holds ORU-0272 (failed, awaiting return shipment), so the pick was framed explicitly on slot_0.
- Site survey: destination pdu_1_shelf/shelf at map [11.75, 4.2265, 0.5]; work stands queried for both features (depot slot_0 stand 1.065 m, shelf stand 1.08 m) and used to choose docking standoffs.
- Catalogue: ORU grasp interface = slot_between_head_and_collar, closing width 0.012 m, handle 0.467 m above base (grasp height 1.017 m above the site frame), release constraint below_overhang.

WHAT WAS DONE (each effect independently verified)
1. navigate_to_feature + dock_at_feature onto depot_stand/slot_0 work pose — base_at_commanded_pose holds (pos err 0.014 m, yaw err 0.002 rad; band 0.06 m / 0.06 rad).
2. pick of the ORU from depot_stand/slot_0 by the neck slot — item_held holds: jaw 0.17 rad on an object, lift 0.146 m, rose_with_gripper true, left-behind image flow 474 px. Declared interface fitted to wrist depth with agreement 0.858 on 515 points, residual 0.5 mm; closure precondition on-contact. Vision saw a black ORU with gray base and T-shaped lifting collar on the depot stand.
3. Carried to PDU-1 (navigate_to_feature then dock_at_feature at pdu_1_shelf/shelf work pose) — item_still_held holds on arrival (jaw 0.17, gray rectangular block seen, confidence 0.8) and base_at_commanded_pose holds (pos err 0.018 m, yaw err 0.001 rad).
4. place on pdu_1_shelf/shelf with release_constraint below_overhang — item_placed holds: jaws open (0.82 rad), let go 5.8 mm below expected shelf height, tool clear of the release point by 0.237 m, post-retreat image flow 0.06 px, item_still true, item_in_settle_view true, 0 points between the open fingers. MOVABLE ITEMS records the item on pdu_1_shelf/shelf.
5. Backed off 1.2 m and stow — arm_stowed holds (posture "stowed"); the arm was not folded until after the item was set down and the release verified.
6. navigate_to_pose to the rover dock (0, 0, 0) — base_at_commanded_pose holds (pos err 0.029 m, yaw err 0.241 rad, inside the 0.25 m / 0.3 rad band). Current robot state: base map (-0.029, -0.005), arm posture stowed, jaw 0.82 rad (open, empty).

AUTHORITY / INTERACTIONS WITH OPERATING INFRASTRUCTURE
- No module was removed from any energized unit's equipment bay and no panel button was pressed; the work touched only the depot stand, the PDU-1 spares shelf and the road network. No mission-control authorization was required or requested; no anomalies, guard denials or refusals remain unresolved.
- PDU-1's own bay (ORU-0211) was left untouched and unpowered-state changes were not made.

UNRESOLVED / NOTES FOR THE RECORD
- The manifest still lists ORU-0417 at depot_stand/slot_0; the logistics record needs updating to pdu_1_shelf/shelf. depot_stand/slot_0 is now empty (ORU-0272 remains in slot_1, failed, awaiting return shipment).
- Identity was established from the manifest plus the pick being taken at the surveyed slot_0 support point; the ORU carries no readable name label, so serial-level confirmation on the shelf is by location, not by marking.
- Delivery was confirmed by the place skill's settle evidence (item resting in the settle view, no motion after release); no separate post-hoc visual re-inspection of the shelf was made after the rover drove away.
- Rover is parked at the dock, arm stowed, gripper empty; no active faults, all capabilities available. Direct-with-Earth link up at report time (Earth sets in ~472 s).
